description: Windenergieanlagen in Deutschland is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by qgis.umweltnavi.info. Wind turbines in Germany that are registered in the market master data register (MaStR) of the Federal Network Agency. Included are both onshore and offshore wind turbines with technical characteristics such as hub height, rotor diameter, manufacturer, type designation and location data (e.g. coordinates, address, state). Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Wind turbines in Germany" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include strom. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
